title: Sinkhorn Distances: Lightspeed Computation of Optimal Transportation Distances
tldr_zh: 给 OT 加熵约束/熵罚，最优耦合为 diag(u)e^{-λM}diag(v)，Sinkhorn–Knopp 缩放求解，比 EMD 快数个量级且 MNIST 分类更好
tldr_en: Entropic regularization turns OT into a strictly convex problem solved by Sinkhorn-Knopp matrix scaling, orders of magnitude faster than EMD solvers, with better MNIST accuracy.
key_numbers: Theorem 1: d_{M,alpha} is symmetric and satisfies the triangle inequality for all alpha >= 0; 1_{r!=c} d_{M,alpha} is a distance
Optimal regularized plan has the form P = diag(u) exp(-lambda M) diag(v) (Eq. 3)
Sinkhorn on CPU is more than 100,000x faster than EMD solvers for large d at tolerance 0.01; GPU adds another order of magnitude (Sec. 5.3, Fig. 4)
Sinkhorn distance stays about 10% above EMD on MNIST pairs even for large lambda (Fig. 3, Sec. 5.2)
MNIST classification: Sinkhorn distance beats EMD, Hellinger, chi2, TV, Gaussian kernels; lambda=9/q50(M) best in most folds, 20 fixed iterations (Fig. 2, curves only)
